common.view_only: You can look at the website here. Changing it needs the website permission; ask the principal or an administrator.
common.start_first: Start the website on the overview first.
common.check_fields: Some fields need a look. They are marked below.

overview.title: Website
overview.text: Your institution's own website: pages, notice board, pictures and contact details.
overview.none_text: A person who may publish the website (usually the principal) can start it here.
overview.publish_text: Everyone will see the pages as they are now. Notices and settings are already live.
overview.publish_first_title: Put the website on the internet?
overview.publish_first_text: Everyone with the address will see the website. You can take it offline at any time.
overview.published: The website is up to date.
overview.offline_text: Visitors will see "not available" until you publish again. Nothing is deleted.
overview.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.
overview.changes_waiting: Some page changes are not on the internet yet. Look at the preview, then publish.
overview.changes_waiting_ask: Some page changes are not on the internet yet. A person who may publish (usually the principal) will publish them.
overview.not_live: Only you and your team can see it, through the preview. Publish when it is ready.
overview.not_live_ask: Only your team can see it, through the preview. A person who may publish will put it online.
overview.is_offline: Visitors see "not available". Publish to bring it back.

start.title: Start your website
start.text: Three short steps. You can change everything later.
start.language_hint: Visitors see this language first. They can switch to the other one.
start.what_next: We make a home page with a welcome, the notice board and your contact details. Nothing is on the internet until you publish.
start.started: Your website is ready to fill in.

templates.school_text: A coloured welcome band, cards and a bold notice board.
templates.minimal_text: White and calm; colour only on links and buttons.
templates.premium_text: Deep ink and gold, serif headings, quiet lines.

settings.title: Website settings
settings.text: Name, address, look and contact details of the website.
settings.name: Name
settings.address_hint: Small letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 63 characters.
settings.address_taken: Another website uses this address. Try another one.
settings.address_invalid: Use small letters, digits and hyphens (not at the start or end), at least 3.
settings.address_unknown: Could not check now. It is checked again when you save.
settings.address_publishers: Only a person who may publish can change the address.
settings.address_change_warning: The old address stops working at once. Links people saved will no longer open.
settings.primary_hint: Header, buttons and links. White text sits on it.
settings.accent_hint: Highlights such as the welcome button.
settings.contrast_low: White text is hard to read on this main colour. Choose a darker one.
settings.contrast_ok: White text is easy to read on the main colour.
settings.logo_hint: A square picture looks best. Without one, the first letter of the name is shown.
settings.contact_map_hint: A Google Maps (or other) link that starts with https://
settings.languages_hint: Visitors can switch between the languages turned on here.
settings.save_hint: Settings show on the website as soon as you save.
settings.share_hint: Shown when the website is shared on Facebook or WhatsApp (1200 × 630 looks best). Without it, the logo.

pages.title: Pages
pages.text: Pages in the order of the website menu. Changes show after you publish.
pages.full: Your plan allows no more pages.
pages.name: Page name
pages.address_hint: Small letters, digits and hyphens, for example "about-us".
pages.remove_text: "{name}" and its {count} blocks will be removed. It stays on the internet until you publish.
pages.seo_text: What Google and shared links show for this page.

editor.text: Blocks from top to bottom, as visitors see them. Changes show after you publish.
editor.missing_text: It may have been removed. Go back to the pages.
editor.empty_text: Add a block: a welcome, some text, the notice board, pictures and more.
editor.remove_text: The "{kind}" block will be removed from this page.
editor.choose_text: Choose what the block shows. You fill it in next.
editor.saved: Block saved. Publish to show it on the internet.

blocks.hero_text: A big title with a picture and a button, at the top of a page.
blocks.text_text: A title and paragraphs, such as "About us".
blocks.admission_text: Admission news with a last date and a button.
blocks.programs_text: Your classes from Education, or a list you write.
blocks.people_text: Teachers, staff or the committee, with photos.
blocks.gallery_text: Pictures from events and the campus.
blocks.downloads_text: PDF files such as forms, routines and results.
blocks.contact_text: Address, phone, email, office hours and map.
blocks.attendance_text: How many students and staff are present today (numbers only).
blocks.slider_text: Big pictures that turn by themselves, each with a title and a button.
blocks.stats_text: A few numbers you are proud of, counting up.

fields.title: Title
fields.link_hint: A full address (https://…) or a page of the website (/about).
fields.name: Name
fields.caption: Caption

notices.title: Notices
notices.text: Notices show on the website as soon as you save, from their date on.
notices.empty_text: Write the first notice: holidays, exam routines, results.
notices.date_hint: Shown on the website from this day.
notices.file_hint: For example the full notice or a routine.
notices.saved_live: Notice saved. It is on the website.
notices.saved_hidden: Notice saved. It is hidden from the website.
notices.remove_text: "{title}" will be removed from the website at once.

media.title: Pictures and files
media.text: Pictures and PDF files used on the website. Pictures are made smaller for fast pages.
media.image_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most {mb} MB each.
media.empty_text: Upload pictures (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and PDF files, at most {mb} MB each.
media.in_use_hint: Used on the website (logo, a block or a notice). Take it out there first.

domain.title: Own domain
domain.text: Put the website on a domain your school owns, such as www.yourschool.edu.bd.
domain.host_hint: Buy it from a domain seller first (for .edu.bd: BTCL).
domain.added: Domain added. Now put the records below in its DNS.
domain.records_text: Ask whoever manages the domain to add these records:
domain.records_hint: DNS changes can take a few minutes up to a day. Then check here; the certificate (https) comes by itself.
domain.name: Name
domain.verified: The domain is proven. The website opens there now.
domain.remove_text: {host} stops showing the website; it opens at {address} again.
domain.not_in_plan: Your plan does not include an own domain. Ask about a bigger plan.
